question: Which of the following peninsular rivers falls into the Arabian Sea?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sabarmati river**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Sabarmati river is one of the major rivers in the western part of India and primarily flows through the state of Gujarat.
 
• It originates from the Aravalli Range in the Udaipur District of Rajasthan.
 
• The river flows in a south-west direction and eventually falls into the Arabian Sea.
 
• Sabarmati river is significant for the city of Ahmedabad, which is situated on the banks of this river.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Mahanadi

 
 
• The Mahanadi river is a major river in East Central India.
 
• It flows through the states of Chhattisgarh and Odisha.
 
• The river finally empties into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Krishna River**
 
 
• The Krishna river is one of the longest rivers in India, flowing through the states of Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, and Andhra Pradesh.
 
• It originates near Mahabaleshwar in Maharashtra.
 
• This river also drains into the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
• **Godavari River**
 
 
• The Godavari river is the second longest river in India after the Ganges.
 
• It flows through the states of Maharashtra, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, and Odisha.
 
• The Godavari river also empties into the Bay of Bengal.
